buyerCountryCode.description: Buyer country code (BT-55), ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (EN 16931 BR-11 / BR-CL-14).

amountDue.description: Amount due for payment (BT-115) = total with VAT - paid amount + rounding amount (EN 16931 BR-15 / BR-CO-16).

paidAmount.description: Paid amount (BT-113), already settled before issue (EN 16931 BR-DEC-16).

roundingAmount.description: Rounding amount (BT-114) applied to the amount due (EN 16931 BR-DEC-17).

taxCurrencyCode.description: VAT accounting currency code (BT-6), ISO 4217 alpha-3 (EN 16931 BR-CL-05 / BR-53).

taxAmountAccountingCurrency.description: Invoice total VAT amount in accounting currency (BT-111); required when taxCurrencyCode is present (EN 16931 BR-53 / BR-DEC-15).

invoicingPeriodStart.description: Invoicing period start date (BT-73); end date must be >= start (EN 16931 BR-29).

actualDeliveryDate.description: Actual delivery date (BT-72); supports the intra-community delivery-info rule (EN 16931 BR-IC-11).

paymentMeansTypeCode.description: Payment means type code (BT-81), UNCL4461 (EN 16931 BR-49 / BR-CL-16).

paymentAccountId.description: Payment account identifier (BT-84); required for credit-transfer payment means (EN 16931 BR-50 / BR-61).

sellerElectronicAddressScheme.description: Seller electronic address scheme identifier (BT-34-1); required when the address is present (EN 16931 BR-62).

buyerElectronicAddressScheme.description: Buyer electronic address scheme identifier (BT-49-1); required when the address is present (EN 16931 BR-63).

sellerTaxRepAddress.description: Seller tax representative postal address (BG-12) (EN 16931 BR-19).

sellerTaxRepCountryCode.description: Seller tax representative country code (BT-69), ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (EN 16931 BR-20).

payeeName.description: Payee name (BT-59); required when a payee different from the seller is given (EN 16931 BR-17).

deliverToCountryCode.description: Deliver-to country code (BT-80); required when a deliver-to address or an intra-community supply is present (EN 16931 BR-57 / BR-IC-12).

supportingDocuments.description: Additional supporting documents (BG-24); each carries a supporting document reference (BT-122) (EN 16931 BR-52).

precedingInvoiceReferences.description: Preceding invoice references (BG-3); each carries a preceding invoice reference (BT-25) (EN 16931 BR-55).
